instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. ATSG is a cargo ACMI/CMI carrier - fuel risk is largely mitigated by reimbursement through ACMI/CMI agreements with customers (DHL, Amazon, etc.). Company does have interest rate swap instruments (required by credit agreement) but these are interest rate hedges, not fuel hedges.

warnings: ATSG is a cargo air carrier (ACMI/CMI operations via ABX Air, Air Transport International). Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to customers via ACMI/CMI agreements. Fuel risk largely mitigated by reimbursement through ACMI agreement with Airborne. No derivative financial instruments at December 31, 2003. No fuel hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Aviation fuel consumption decreased 3.3% to 148.0 million gallons in 2003 compared to 153.0 million gallons in 2002.
